mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction permits and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand for durable goods and housing, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 2050.0 and RSAFS > 340000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 115.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 115.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPI) above 2.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that triggers a forward-looking expectation of tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.0 in the prior month and FEDFUNDS <= 4.0
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 330,000 million dollars, combined with a falling GDP growth rate, indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 330000.0 and GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 330000.0 and GDPC1 growth < 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal fails to generate negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 134,000 thousand signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 134000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 134000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 95.0 index level, combined with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a supply-side shock coupled with weakening labor demand, which increases corporate cost pressures and reduces earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 95.0 and UNRATE > 4.8 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 95.0 and UNRATE > 4.8 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year window.
